A published 2026 mathematical finding already proves the two primitive three-cycles for all triangle geometries, so that fact is expressly excluded from any novelty claim. value.rationale: The global basins and countably exceptional midpoint captures complete the dynamics of a natural symmetric case left quantitatively unresolved by qualitative convergence results. The exact 1/3–2/3 liminf/limsup is a nontrivial large-scale consequence of two genuine coexisting attractors and dyadic entrance-time shells, and is sharply distinguished from two-sided density; the theorem also identifies all stationary probability measures. The restriction to equilateral complete lines is geometrically natural and fully disclosed.
